svg.title: The proof: dough rising in a tub as the stack goes in
svg.desc: The proof: a tub of dough rises past its gold starting band as the parts go in one by one. 08:00 Mix. sourdough new picks the shape. In 0.1 that's raw PHP. 08:20 Flour: WayneUI. The interface, from WayneUI's standalone PHP file, which you download once. 08:40 Water: SESAME. Sign-in. A fake driver locally, CAS in production. 09:00 Salt: HELMET. Security headers, a hardened session, and /up for the load balancer. 10:30 Levain: PROCTOR. The standards check. Preflight's CI components run it on every push, along with the tests and a Composer audit. 13:00 Doubled. Well past the gold band. A label goes on: .sourdough/manifest.json. 14:00 Divide and shape. Cut into the five shapes the stack plans for. Any day: sourdough manifest --check. Is it still alive? Lists every managed file that has drifted from the manifest. Run it in the app; the generated CI doesn't run it for you.
svg.text: where it started: the gold band
What goes into the tub when you run sourdough new.
